description: This file defines the Renderer class, a base class for vector rendering in the Leaflet mapping library, handling DOM container, bounds, zoom animations, and interactions with map layers.

classes.name: Renderer
classes.description: A base class for vector renderers (SVG, Canvas) in Leaflet, managing container, bounds, zoom, and layer interactions.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets options, assigns a unique stamp, and initializes the layers object.

methods.name: onAdd
methods.description: Prepares the container, adds zoom class if animated, appends to map pane, and updates.

methods.name: onRemove
methods.description: Removes event listeners and destroys the container.

methods.name: getEvents
methods.description: Returns event handlers for map interactions like reset, zoom, moveend, zoomend, and zoom animation.

methods.name: _onAnimZoom
methods.description: Handles animated zoom events by updating transform.

methods.name: _onZoom
methods.description: Handles zoom events by updating transform.

methods.name: _updateTransform
methods.description: Calculates and applies scale and position transforms based on map center and zoom.

methods.name: _reset
methods.description: Resets the renderer and its layers.

methods.name: _onZoomEnd
methods.description: Projects all layers after zoom ends.

methods.name: _update
methods.description: Updates renderer bounds, center, and zoom based on map state.
